$comment: CANONICAL: what belongs to ONE brain and is therefore NOT a template.
Three releases in a row shipped or clobbered a file because this list lived
in several places at once and they drifted:
naming 16 third-party repos inside the npm tarball
3.25.2  research-queue.jsonl shipped the developer's queued topics, and
sync-repo would have overwritten one repo's 7 real entries
A path listed here must never be: published in the package, written into
scaffold/, or overwritten by a template sync. If a file records what THIS
brain has done, seen, or been configured with, it belongs here.
This is NOT the backup-exclusion list. Some of these (config/,
skills-registry/) are state worth backing up; they simply are not templates.
Backup exclusions live in ensureBrainGitignore and answer a different
